title: Sonika Video Downloader: free and open source
summary: Free websites for downloading Instagram, YouTube and Pinterest videos are loaded with ads. So I made Sonika Video Downloader: copy the link, paste it, and download in up to 4K. It's free, open source, runs offline on your computer, with no sign-in and no subscription.
steps: Download the app from this page (Windows 10/11).
Copy the link of a YouTube, Instagram or Pinterest video.
Paste it into the app and pick the quality (up to 4K when the video has it).
Found a bug? Use the feedback form on this website. I check it myself.

prompts.title: Write a clear bug report
prompts.text:
Help me write a clear bug report for a free app, Sonika Video Downloader.

What happened: [DESCRIBE THE PROBLEM IN YOUR OWN WORDS].
What I expected: [WHAT SHOULD HAVE HAPPENED].
My PC: [WINDOWS 10 or 11], app version [IF SHOWN].
Link type: [YOUTUBE / INSTAGRAM / PINTEREST]. Don't include the private link itself if it's not public.
Error message: [PASTE IT OR DESCRIBE THE SCREENSHOT].

Turn this into a short report with: title, steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, PC details. Keep it under 120 words so I can paste it into the feedback form.

prompts.title: Organise my downloaded references
prompts.text:
My downloads folder for reference videos is a mess: [FOLDER PATH].

Plan a clean structure, for example by platform (YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest) and by type (hooks, transitions, graphics, b-roll).
1. Show me the folder plan and a list of which file goes where.
2. Suggest clear file names: [DATE]_[PLATFORM]_[SHORT DESCRIPTION].

This is a dry run. Don't move, rename or delete anything until I say OK. Never delete files.

notes: Only download videos you own or have permission to use.
Works with YouTube, Instagram and Pinterest. Windows 10/11.
Open source: the GitHub repo is public.
